name: Caroline Polachek
notes: Virtuoso art-pop with the voice used as a synthesiser. The drums are authored from a split claim: "Harle-produced tracks use rave-derived kick and clap patterns and trance arpeggios as the rhythmic bed; other tracks replace drums entirely with breath, field recording and vocal percussion." So the kick sits four-on-the-floor while the perc lanes are `perc`, `perc2` and `shaker` at a density that reaches 0 — the pulseless tracks the entry names — and `hihat.continuous` is false because the arpeggio, not the hat, is the bed. The low end is a floor, not a groove: "sub-bass sine tones and organ-like bass pedals; the low end is a harmonic floor, not a groove", which is a kick mirror at `followRootsProb` 0.95 with a low `anticipationProb` and no `bass808` block. Harmony is "modal and pentatonic writing — she cites Japanese pentatonic tonality with angular melodies as a formative influence; harmony is often a static drone with melodic motion supplying the tension", so `scales` carries `minor_pentatonic` and `major_pentatonic` at real weight, `maxChords` drops to 3 and `harmonicRhythm` is vamp-dominant with the longest chord windows here. The melody block is the model: "toplines use very wide leaps, fast melisma, and long sustained notes with vibrato automation", which is the highest `leap` share and the widest register in this section, plus `endVariation` for the melisma. The counter is the multitracked formant-processed vocal. ⚠ `confidence` is medium and the research says "tempo/rhythm detail inferred": every drum probability, the humanize numbers and `bpm.mode` 112 (the midpoint of the stated 90—135 band) are INFERRED. ⛔ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than `reese_sustain`, and that is an engine limit rather than a reading of the record.** `reese_sustain` is the only rhythm `bass.rs` reads that holds a note, and it emits one note per chord — TASK-162, still open — so this model measured **212 distinct basslines in 1,000 seeds** on it against `bass.rs`'s floor of 500. `mirror_kick` with a high root lock is the roster-wide substitution for a sustained sub (`dmx`, `coolio`, `krs-one`, `mobb-deep` all record the same one), and over a kick that plays the Harle rave four-on-the-floor it reads as held at this tempo. The research is *"sub-bass sine tones and organ-like bass pedals; the low end is a harmonic floor, not a groove"*, so `followRootsProb` stays at 0.95 and the pedal is what the part still plays. ⚠ **INFERRED:** `anticipationProb` 0.12 is not sourced; it is the smallest push that gives a floor-and-pedal bass a reachable seed space over a kick this regular.
